  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Manchester < Old English Mameceaster (Mam + ceaster); ceaster = Roman fort/city; Arena < Latin harena = sand, sandy place",
    "reading": "A sanded Roman fort-city — the place of the encircling wall and the dust of contest.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "ang"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Lewis & Short Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.9

  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Man + chester + arena; 'man' = human, 'chester' = camp, 'arena' = sand; man-ches-ter = 'man's chest' (heart) + 'air' (arena)",
    "reading": "The human chest's arena — where breath and heart contend in the sand of being.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Manchester → French 'manche' (sleeve/handle) + 'ster' (star, via German); Arena → Latin 'harena' → French 'arène'",
    "reading": "Sleeve of the star, the sandy ring — a garment of celestial dust for the spectacle.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "de", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Manchester Arena → 'Crane, heat, mars, sea' + 'arena' → 'Crane mars the sea'",
    "reading": "A crane (bird of Hermes) mars the sea — the bird's language stirs the waters of the arena.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "M-A-R-E-A → Latin 'mare' (sea) + 'a' (from) + 'rena' (sand); Manchester = 'man' + 'chester' (camp)",
    "reading": "From the sea's sand, the camp of man — the arena as a shore of gathered dust.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "M = 13 (death/transformation), A = 1 (beginning), R = 18 (sun), E = 5 (life), A = 1; Manchester = M (13) + C (3) + H (8) + E (5) + S (19) + T (20) + E (5) + R (18)",
    "reading": "Death begins, sun lives — the camp's letters sum to 91 (13+3+8+5+19+20+5+18), the number of Amen.",
    "languages": ["en", "he", "grc"],
    "source": "generative (numerological tradition)",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Manchester = 13+1+14+3+8+5+19+20+5+18 = 106; Arena = 1+18+5+14+1 = 39; total = 145",
    "reading": "106 (the number of the 'man' in Hebrew gematria? no, 106 = 'kol' in Greek? — 145 = 'I am' in Greek (145 = εγω ειμι?) — the arena speaks 'I am'.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Arena < Latin harena; also 'harenosus' = sandy; Manchester < Old English 'Mameceaster' — 'Mam' possibly from Celtic 'mamm' = breast/hill",
    "reading": "The breast-shaped hill of the fort, the sandy place — a mother's mound for the gladiator's dust.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "cel"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Pokorny's Indo-European Etymological Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Man + chester + arena; 'chester' sounds like 'chest-er' — one who chests; 'arena' sounds like 'air-ena' (air + ena, Greek 'one')",
    "reading": "The one who chests the air — a breathing being in the sandy circle of time.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Manchester → Arabic 'man' (من) = who, 'chester' → 'kisra' (كسرة) = break; Arena → Hebrew 'arena' (ארנה) = ark (as in Noah's)",
    "reading": "Who breaks the ark? — the sandy ring as a vessel of covenant, shattered by the bird's cry.",
    "languages": ["en", "ar", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Manchester Arena → 'A crane, a rest, a hen, a mare' — 'crane' + 'rest' + 'hen' + 'mare'",
    "reading": "A crane rests, a hen and a mare — the animal alphabet of the arena's silent menagerie.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "M-A-N-C-H-E-S-T-E-R → 'Mater, Anima, Natura, Corpus, Hyle, Ego, Spiritus, Tempus, Eternitas, Ratio' (Latin terms)",
    "reading": "Mother, soul, nature, body, matter, self, spirit, time, eternity, reason — the arena as a sum of all being.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative (alchemical tradition)",
    "confidence": 0.2
  }
]
